snippet.text: def refreeze (A: Levels G)(p k:ℕ)(x y:ℝ)(t:B.Mode)(s:V→ℝ):ℝ:= Real.exp (Fintype.card (Site (A.S.side k p))*Vac.treasury A k+Fintype.card V*(x+y+2*1)) / Poly.toll s t

proof_context.conclusion: `refreeze` is `exp(card(Site) * treasury + card V * (x+y+2)) / Poly.toll s t`, with `Poly.toll` the product of weights.
